competing_explanation: Matching counts alone could have hidden a changed or incomplete data copy; the ordered aggregate SHA-256 binds every supported image path, size and content identity. This still does not establish model quality, source independence from OTS training data or unseen-domain generalization.

SOTS-Outdoor contains exactly 492 GT images and 500 hazy images.
All 500 hazy images map to 492 GT source groups with zero unmapped hazy images and zero unused GT images.
The complete ordered SOTS-Outdoor file census has aggregate SHA-256 ac6921cc9a2afd32c9976465fd9a50555dce2f217f8f4ddb0614c907f681e5b2.
limitations: No model was loaded and no inference, restoration metric or training was performed.
The audit does not establish that SOTS clear sources are independent of OTS training sources.
SOTS-Outdoor may support official-domain diagnostic measurement but cannot by itself support a strict unseen-generalization claim.
The pass authorizes only the separately frozen local GT-error measurement contract.
primary_result: The exact official OTS checkpoint and the complete paired SOTS-Outdoor copy satisfy the frozen identity, count, source-pairing and aggregate-digest gates, so they are qualified for authoring the next local GT-error diagnostic contract.
